abstract: Read-only two-way match of vendor bills against purchase orders through the Apideck MCP server. Lists bills whose amount, quantity or unit price differs from the purchase order by more than a tolerance, bills that point at a missing or closed PO, and large bills with no PO, on QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, Business Central, Odoo, Pennylane, Zoho Books and any other connector with purchase orders.
